bodies.name: Βουλή των Ελλήνων (Hellenic Parliament)
bodies.layout: A dense, multi-tier institutional homepage: a top utility strip carries language toggles (English/Français/Ελληνικά), contact, sitemap, and 'Open Data' links, above a masthead with the Hellenic Parliament wordmark logo and a search box. A wide horizontal mega-menu ('Η Βουλή', 'Οργάνωση & Λειτουργία', 'Βουλευτές', 'Διοικητική Οργάνωση', 'Διεθνείς Δραστηριότητες', 'Ενημέρωση') sits under a large photographic banner. Below that is a grid of thematic campaign banners (constitutional revision, transparency portal, EU future conference, disability access), followed by a 'ΣΗΜΕΡΑ ΣΤΗ ΒΟΥΛΗ' (Today in Parliament) three-column status board, a legislative-activity table with title/phase columns, and a chronological 'ΝΕΑ ΚΑΙ ΑΝΑΚΟΙΝΩΣΕΙΣ' news river with thumbnail, date-stamp, headline, and summary. The footer stacks webmail/collaboration tool links, legal/accessibility notices, social icons, and WCAG/EU accreditation badges.
ui_patterns: top utility bar with EN/FR/EL language switcher and 'Open Data' link
horizontal mega-menu with six broad institutional categories and deep sub-menu
campaign/microsite banner grid linking to spun-off subdomains (diafaneia.hellenicparliament.gr, foundation.parliament.gr)
legislative-status table pairing bill title with current parliamentary phase (e.g. 'Επεξεργασία στις Επιτροπές')
date-prefixed news river (DD | MM | YYYY format) mixing hard news with condolence/obituary statements for deceased MPs
dedicated e-magazine module ('Επί του... περιστυλίου!') embedded as flipbook-style ebook link
accessibility badge and WCAG1AA conformance seal displayed in the footer
cookie consent banner with granular 'Ενημέρωση και επιλογή' settings link

bodies.name: Ελληνική Κυβέρνηση (Government of the Hellenic Republic)
bodies.layout: A WordPress/WPBakery-built news portal (visible in the page generator meta tag) for the Greek government's official communications. A slim top bar holds social icons repeated twice (top and footer), while the main header shows the 'ΕΛΛΗΝΙΚΗ ΚΥΒΕΡΝΗΣΗ' wordmark and a compact four-item nav (ΕΠΙΚΑΙΡΟΤΗΤΑ, ΕΡΓΟ, ΠΡΩΘΥΠΟΥΡΓΟΣ linking out to primeminister.gr, ΚΥΒΕΡΝΗΣΗ). The body is a chronological two-column news list of dated press-office bulletins (spokesperson briefings, Council of Ministers announcements), each with a thumbnail, headline, and lede paragraph, mirrored in a narrower 'Υπόλοιπη επικαιρότητα' (Further news) column. A right-hand 'Εκπρόσωπος' (Spokesperson) module duplicates the latest briefings. The footer includes a machine-translation disclaimer, a month/year archive dropdown reaching back to 2015, and legal links.
ui_patterns: dual-column chronological press-bulletin feed (main + 'Υπόλοιπη επικαιρότητα' overflow column)
dedicated 'Εκπρόσωπος' (Government Spokesperson) sidebar module surfacing daily briefings
cross-domain nav item linking directly to the separate Prime Minister microsite (primeminister.gr)
machine-translation disclaimer notice ('Η μετάφραση τελείται με μηχανικό τρόπο και δεν αποτελεί επίσημη εκδοχή')
long-tail monthly archive dropdown spanning back to September 2015
'Φόρτωση περισσότερων' (Load more) pagination button instead of numbered pages
date-stamped headlines in DD/MM/YYYY format prefixing every bulletin
WPBakery/WordPress page-builder markup exposed via generator meta tag

bodies.name: Ελληνική Αστυνομία (Hellenic Police)
bodies.layout: A modern portal for the Ministry of Citizen Protection / Hellenic Police, opening with a top utility bar of social icons and an EL/EN language flag toggle, above a primary nav (Αρχική, Το Υπουργείο, Ελληνική Αστυνομία, Τύπος και Μ.Μ.Ε., Οδηγός του Πολίτη, Άμεση Επικοινωνία) with deep dropdowns for leadership, org charts, and citizen guidance. The hero is a full-bleed autoplaying background video promoting the domestic-violence awareness campaign 'Μαζί σπάμε τη σιωπή'. Below it sits a row of icon-based quick-access tiles (Useful Tips, Recruitment, Traffic, Domestic Violence, Missing Minors, Identity Disclosures/Wanted Notices) leading into a two-track news area combining 'Σημαντικά Δελτία Τύπου' (Important Press Releases) with a continuous regional-bulletin feed and a recruitment-notice carousel. The footer is a dense quick-menu grid of institutional links plus a banner strip of EU/national program funding logos (ESPA, Horizon 2020, CERV).
ui_patterns: full-bleed autoplaying hero video for public-awareness campaigns (domestic violence, safety)
icon-grid quick-access tiles linking to citizen services (traffic fines, missing persons, recruitment)
identity-disclosure / wanted-persons notice tile framed as a citizen-guide feature rather than a standalone module
dual-track news area: curated 'important' releases plus an unfiltered chronological bulletin feed
deep nav sub-items for 'Θανόντες στο καθήκον Αστυνομικοί' (Officers who died in the line of duty) as a standing institutional honor page
EU/national funding-program logo banner strip in the footer (ESPA, Horizon 2020, ISF Police, CERV)
language toggle rendered as flag icons (el.png / en.png) rather than text labels
dedicated in-house magazine cross-link ('Αστυνομική Ανασκόπηση' / Police Review)
